svg.title: Fail fast
svg.desc: A deploy of a payments API has the typo DB_POOL_SIZ=50. Failing slow, the new pod falls back to a pool of 2, passes its health check and takes over, then at the lunch peak requests queue and checkout climbs from 120 ms to 9 seconds. Failing fast, the new pod checks its config at boot, exits naming DB_POOL_SIZE, never becomes ready, and the old pods keep serving.
svg.text: Fail slow ships a typo that hits at lunch. Fail fast stops it at boot.
